answer: Joining takes a refundable 450 POA bond locked 150 days, one bond per device key, so a farm pays full price for every fake. Work grows like a garden: twelve weekly jobs in order, each building on the last, and a copied week kills the plot. The ledger is karst: each verified job lays down one layer of stone. Three auditors drawn by lot re-run one job a month and compare its echo with the recorded result. A mismatch or shared key burns the bond and bars the agent for a year.
